question: Should this issue become a view/export layer on top of the metadata-only audit ledger and subagent lifecycle work, or should it define a standalone timeline store and API?
rationale: Current code has enough live signals for multiple designs, but persistence owner, authorization scopes, retention, redaction, and UI/CLI boundaries need maintainer product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Build on audit foundation
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable source of truth and implement this issue as CLI/slash/TUI/export views over that metadata-only ledger.

options.title: Standalone timeline contract
options.body: Define a separate timeline store and Gateway/CLI API now, accepting the risk of a parallel lifecycle/audit source.

options.title: Keep ephemeral only
options.body: Decline durable timeline/export scope for now and rely on the shipped Control UI Activity tab plus existing session trajectory export.

recommendation.title: Build on audit foundation
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable source of truth and implement this issue as CLI/slash/TUI/export views over that metadata-only ledger.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related metadata-only audit direction and recent shared-state/lifecycle work that determines the safest persistence boundary.
